rows.name:
Welcome, mooo! Yutayuta brought
accessories all the way out to remote
Liberalitas, mooo!

rows.label: tlk42450261_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Country folk should pay more attention
to fashion, mooo! Yutayuta won't allow
frumpiness, mooo!

rows.label: tlk42450261_01_msg0003
rows.name:
You've made a good purchase, mooo!
That should make you less frumpy,
mooo!

rows.label: tlk42450261_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Oh my, mooo! Do you actually prefer
looking frumpy, mooo?
